lyrics:
[Intro: electric piano, soft strings, a harp glissando]

[Verse 1: female voice, controlled and quiet]
You've started knocking on the bathroom door
You've started asking if I'm warm
You fold my scarves, you bring me tea
You've stopped looking straight at me

[Pre-Chorus: drums enter, voice lifting]
I am not a thing that breaks
I am not a careful place

[Chorus: full orchestra, voice soaring]
Stay and see me
All the rooms, even that one
Don't be gentle, don't be kind
Be here, and don't run
I can stand the truth of this
If you are standing in it, too
Stay and see me
The way I still see you

[Verse 2: key up a step, voice stronger]
There's a scar now where there wasn't
There are mornings I can't stand
There's a girl you met at twenty
In here, holding out her hand

[Pre-Chorus: drums build, brass in]
Don't you dare go polite on me
Don't you dare go away

[Chorus: full orchestra, voice soaring]
Stay and see me
All the rooms, even that one
Don't be gentle, don't be kind
Be here, and don't run
I can stand the truth of this
If you are standing in it, too
Stay and see me
The way I still see you

[Bridge: band drops, saxophone and voice]
Look at me. No, look.
There. That's all I want.

[Final Chorus: key up again, biggest, held last note]
Stay and see me
All the rooms, even that one
Don't be gentle, don't be kind
Be here, and don't run
I can stand the truth of this
If you are standing in it, too
Stay and see me
The way I still see you

[Outro: electric piano, a held breath let go, "I see you."]
producerBrief:
TEMPO / KEY / FEEL: 60 BPM, 4/4, G major, rising to A major at verse 2 and to B-flat major for the last chorus. Slow, grand and exposed.

VOICE: Female, a commanding gospel-trained soprano with enormous range and control. Soft and precise in verse 1, growing in each section, with melismatic runs and a final note held at full power. A man speaks three words at the very end.

INSTRUMENTS: Electric piano, a full orchestra with strings, brass and harp, a fretless-style bass, a restrained drum kit with big tom fills into each chorus, a tenor saxophone in the bridge, timpani at the key changes.

ARRANGEMENT MAP: 0:00 Intro. 0:16 Verse 1. 0:48 Pre-chorus. 1:00 Chorus 1. 1:40 Verse 2, key up. 2:12 Pre-chorus. 2:24 Chorus 2. 3:04 Bridge, saxophone. 3:22 Final chorus, key up again. 4:06 Outro, three spoken words at 4:22.

PRODUCTION & MIX: Early-1990s film ballad: lavish, polished and orchestral, the voice far in front of everything.

SIGNATURE MOMENT: The second key change into the final chorus at 3:22.

MODERN POINT OF VIEW: The original asks a lover not to walk away. A woman of fifty with a new scar is asking for something more exact: not to be handled, and not to be looked past.

EMOTIONAL ARC: Hurt, insisting, exposed, seen.
